endpoint_eligibility.brier_score: development-only after a source-blind calibrator is fit without the evaluated source
endpoint_eligibility.held_source_auprc: eligible as nested development cross-source recovery only after all leakage gates pass
endpoint_eligibility.open_champion: ineligible because datasets_sealed is empty and the executable promotion gate permits only blocked_missing_sealed_source

current_coloc_gwas.allowed_use: Outer-training graph evidence only after the corrected 50-study COLOC release is promoted. Native-build LD and locus grouping precede graph construction.
current_coloc_gwas.warning: Current memberships are exposed and provisional; no local checkpoint may be created from them before promotion.

gse281160.allowed_use: Development-only source-recovery diagnostic. Aggregate same-cell guide and RNA evidence to experimental replicate, target locus, and guide family before graph edges are constructed.
gse281160.topology: same_cell guide and RNA; cells and guides are not biological replicates
gse281160.warning: The 20 targets were MPRA-selected and are not an unbiased source seal.

gse281364.allowed_use: Development-only source-recovery diagnostic grouped by locus and sequence identity. MPRA reporter activity is not an endogenous enhancer-gene link unless an independently registered mapping supports that edge type.
gse281364.topology: same_sample_different_aliquot DNA and RNA counts; 16 experimental replicates

gse289173.allowed_use: none for the typed-evidence graph task under the current TaskSpec
gse289173.reason: It is not a registered graph hold-back and its cell-state or QTL outcomes cannot be imported to create one.

resource_gene_catalog_current.allowed_use: Exposed development graph content only after a promoted immutable snapshot. Frozen Resource evidence classes, thresholds, hero genes, and 117 programs cannot become graph training targets or be redefined by model output.

held_source_protocol.calibration: Fit any probability calibrator using predictions and labels from remaining source-held development folds only. The evaluated source contributes no calibration row, prevalence, threshold, or class weight.
held_source_protocol.decoder: Train one source-agnostic candidate-gene head. Do not instantiate or query a held-source-specific relation embedding or decoder parameter.
held_source_protocol.graph_removal: Before graph construction, delete every held-source edge, inverse edge, source node, provenance field, assay-observability mask, derived path, aggregate, degree, source count, feature, normalization statistic, and duplicate alias.
held_source_protocol.negative_sampling: Generate training negatives separately within each remaining source's eligible tested universe. Untestable, not-applicable, structurally missing, join-unresolved, or simply absent edges are not negatives.
held_source_protocol.node_universe: Construct variants, loci, and genes from source-independent registries frozen before source removal. A node or candidate introduced only because the held source assayed it is evaluator-only.
held_source_protocol.split: Group native-build LD blocks, loci, source aliases, genes, and every deterministic derivative before graph construction. Remove held-locus incident edges and a frozen message-passing neighborhood where required by the outer split.
held_source_protocol.success_interpretation: A score can show that remaining evidence prioritizes genes later supported by the removed source. It cannot establish causality or predict the semantics of an unseen relation.

induction_contract.feature_lane: Conditionally inductive to unseen nodes of existing schema only when all node features are computed by a frozen source-independent transform and no entity-ID embedding is used.
induction_contract.new_relation: unsupported; a wholly unseen relation has untrained RGCN parameters
induction_contract.transductive_lane: Permitted only as an explicitly labeled fixed-node-universe development comparator. Node existence must not derive from the held source.

missingness_and_semantics.missingness_rule: No missing, untested, unavailable, or held evidence state is encoded as a zero-valued negative edge.
missingness_and_semantics.native_operator_gap: RGCNConv has no continuous edge-feature argument. Any discretization or feature projection must retain assay-native meaning, explicit masks, and provenance and must be frozen before fitting.
missingness_and_semantics.scientific_language: Use colocalized or genetically anchored candidate and prioritization. Never causal gene from COLOC or graph rank alone.

reproducibility_contract.graph_receipt: Hash the promoted input rows, canonical node IDs, directed typed edges, inverse edges, source provenance, explicit missing states, removed-source list, and every derivative feature before fitting.
reproducibility_contract.local_artifact: Freeze architecture, relation order, graph receipt, outer role, decoder, negative samples, calibration folds, seed, environment, tensors, and predictions for every fitted model.
reproducibility_contract.statistical_unit: independent locus; seeds, edges, variants, genes, guides, and cells are not independent biological replicates
